titel: Your Dog Eating Grass Isn't Sick

beats.say: Your dog eating grass... is *not* sick.
So Rudi builds a *fence*, to keep the dog off the grass. It just eats right *through* it.
The fence didn't work, so Rudi decided to move to the *fortieth floor.* But look what grows on the *balcony.*
Meanwhile, UC Davis asked over *fifteen hundred* dog owners.
Only about *one in ten* dogs looked sick before grazing.
Another study counted *374* grass snacks... and just *two* vomits.
Most dogs eat grass because they simply *like* it.
Just skip *sprayed* lawns, and call the vet if it suddenly eats *loads.*
